data.headline: Executive Assistant to, Chief Information Officer
data.about: I am blessed to be part of a very special team given the distinct honor of matching uniquely talented people to amazing opportunities! My strengths are in both Technical Sourcing/Recruiting and Recruiting Coordination. I apply my strengths in however they can best meet the needs of the organization. The companies I align my career with are those that have a measurable and demonstrated impact on the world we live in, and are passionate about their mission and vision to get there!

experiences.title: Executive Assistant to SVP, Chief Technology & Innovation Officer
experiences.subtitle: Medtronic . Full-time
experiences.caption: May 2024 - Feb 2026 · 1 yr 9 mos

description.text:
Provide high-level administrative support to executive leadership, managing communications, coordinating complex calendars, organizing meetings and conferences, arranging travel, and processing expense reports with precision and discretion.

· Conduct in-depth travel research, oversee visa applications, and coordinate multifaceted itineraries to ensure smooth and efficient travel experiences for executives.

· Manage and align calendars for critical executive engagements, including Board Meetings, Town Halls, Senior Leadership Team sessions, and confidential one-on-one meetings.

· Lead the planning and execution of high-impact meetings and events, handling logistics for audio/video conferencing, agenda development, materials preparation, action tracking, travel coordination, and catering.

· Draft, edit, and proofread executive-level communications, presentations, reports, and internal documents, ensuring clarity, professionalism, and alignment with organizational standards.

· Act as a trusted resource for organizational policies and procedures, promoting consistent and accurate information flow across departments and teams.

experiences.title: Executive Assistant to Vice President of Consumer Robotics
experiences.subtitle: Amazon . Full-time
experiences.caption: Mar 2023 - May 2024 · 1 yr 2 mos

description.text:
· Supported 4 Directors with an org size of 1000

· Drove implementation of bi-weekly meetings with Directors and direct reports, these included insightful reporting and req prioritization.

· Regular reporting on calibrated interviewers across the organization, while providing suggestions for BRIT nominations based on tenure, interviews completed and written feedback.

· Influenced leaders to pivot focus onto senior engineering roles to ensure appropriate level ratios.

· Partnered with 4 Directors and 8 partner teams to drive open reqs down from 466% to 2% in 30 days 

· Ended 2022 with business at 96% of hiring goal for fixed cost centers and 120% for variable

· Created “Inclusion Advocates” team within org focusing on increasing visibility and awareness of affinity group community and opportunity for TA and aligned business to partner more closely on diversity hiring retention.

· Owned relationships with 140+ business leaders and led the hiring efforts for both tech and non-tech job families within the AWS-Commerce Platform organization.

· Responsible for educating new Hiring Managers on the hiring process

· Ensured all interviewers were calibrated to each role

· Developed and implemented innovative sourcing strategies across the team

· Provided total addressable market research

· Averaged 90 offer accepts each year

· Maintained an 85% acceptance rate

· Created and implemented weekly reporting for aligned business groups, providing candidate pipeline updates, time to fill projections and process updates when needed

· Drove a global compensation project, partnering with HR, Compensation and business resulting in a much needed job code change.

· Trained and mentored new sourcing recruiters as our team grew from 4 to 22

· Trained and mentored 3 new Client Lead recruiters

· Created new recruiter training for team helping to reduce ramp time from 6 months to 3 months

· Moderated HERstory roundtable in celebration of Women’s History Month. This brought women in leadership within the organization together to share their success and struggles throughout their careers with a broad audience.

· Created a program that helped share candidates across the org that were deemed a fit for Amazon but were ultimately not hired for the role or team interviewed.

· Hired across multiple domains, exceeding targets every single quarter

· Delivered an average role fill time of 60-90 days.

· Successfully sourced and recruited for SDEs,SDMs,TPMs QAEs, SDETs, and Product Managers

· Provided continued training for Hiring Managers from the Graphiq acquisition 

· Helped to assimilate the Graphic team into the Amazon Culture

· Responsible for developing new sourcing strategies based on business need and demand

· Employee Referral SME

· Created “Project Lift Off” a structured path for recruiting coordinators interested in moving into a sourcing role

· First coordinator hired for Amazon Alexa in Sunnyvale, supporting 5 verticals spanning several time zones.

· Scheduled 70 phone screens and 50 onsite interviews monthly while meeting SLA’s

· Reconciled conflicting schedules to prevent delays in the interview process

· Helped hire, train and mentor 3 new coordinators for Alexa in Sunnyvale

· Created “Raise a Beer with a Bar Raiser” event to create inclusion and collaboration across the business and Bar Raisers.
